sloka: स हत्वा राक्षसान् सर्वान् यज्ञ घ्नान् रघुनंदनः ।ऋषिभिः पूजितः तत्र यथा इन्द्रो विजये पुरा ॥१-३०-२४॥
transliteration: sa hatvā rākṣasān sarvān yajña ghnān raghunaṁdanaḥ ।ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaḥ tatra yathā indro vijaye purā ॥1-30-24॥

translations.english: Thereafter, when the sacrifice was completed, maharshi Viswamitra beholding all the directions bereft of evils, said to Rama:
